ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All persons identified through UBO piercing, including each natural person holding 25% or more directly or indirectly, and the legal representative and senior managers, must be screened against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council 1267/1988/2231 sanctions and consolidated OFAC regime, EU consolidated financial sanctions, and the PRC Ministry of Public Security and PBOC supervision lists before incorporation. Enhanced scrutiny is applied to politically exposed persons (PEPs) and their immediate families and close associates, requiring documented source of funds and senior-management approval. Screening must be repeated before each project-milestone payment; automatic negative-news alerts and transaction monitoring trigger enhanced due diligence and suspension if any match approximates 100% TIN or name/date-of-birth similarity.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: SAMR National Enterprise Registration Online Service Platform (National Market Entity Name Registration and Reservation System)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Chinese law requires a Chinese-language name. The four-tier statutory name formula for a WFOE limited liability company is: [administrative division] + [unique distinctive name] + [industry or business characteristic] + [company form]. Pinyin transliteration alone cannot be the registered name; a foreign-language corresponding name may be recorded only as a supplement. Each segment must not exceed statutory length; characters must be standardized simplified Chinese, and no English letters, Arabic numerals or symbols are allowed except for approved abbreviation rules such as 'Co., Ltd.'
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant must obtain a written rejection notice stating the legal basis and the specific prohibited or conflicting component. If the defect concerns composition or a sensitive token, the applicant may revise and resubmit the name within the same reservation window. If the name is otherwise unique but refused, the applicant must file an administrative reconsideration application with the market supervision administration at the next higher level within 60 days after receipt of the rejection notice. If the reconsideration confirms the rejection, or if reconsideration is not pursued, the applicant may file an administrative lawsuit with the competent people's court within 15 days after the reconsideration decision or within 6 months from the original rejection, citing the registration number and providing evidence of prior identical-name registrations to demonstrate absence of confusion.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: For an EPC WFOE in the solar farm construction industry, a virtual office or commercial mailbox is not permissible. SAMR requires the registered address to be a fixed commercial premise within the jurisdiction; the tax authority will deny VAT invoice issuance and may treat the enterprise as lacking actual management for tax purposes if no physical office exists; banks will reject corporate account opening unless a site inspection confirms physical operations. A virtual office would also breach commercial substance requirements under the PRC General Anti-Avoidance Rules and can lead to cancellation of registration.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Checklist: (1) displayed Chinese company name plate; (2) original lease agreement and property ownership certificate of the lessor; (3) actual staff presence; (4) independent desks, telephony and utilities; (5) project contract and construction permit files; (6) accounting books and tax filing records; (7) bank account statements and payment documents; (8) statutory EPC and safety licenses. Quantified risk: 60% probability of an unannounced physical inspection by the municipal market supervision administration or tax bureau during the first twelve months, rising to 75% if the WFOE claims substantial office rent deductions or applies for large-value VAT invoices.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (adopted 29 December 1993; comprehensively revised 29 December 2023; effective 1 July 2024), especially Articles 4, 9, 22-27, 31-34, 46-50, 57-68 and 179-183; Foreign Investment Law of the PRC (2019, effective 1 January 2020), Articles 4, 6, 28-32; Administrative Regulations on the Registration of Market Entities (State Council Order No. 746, effective 1 March 2022), Articles 2, 8 and 10-15; and the Provisions on the Administration of Establishment and Change Registration of Foreign-Invested Companies (SAMR Order No. 40, as amended).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Market Supervision Administration (MSA) of the city or province where the registered office is located, exercising the delegated registration functions of the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) through the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System (NECIPS) and the China Integrated Enterprise Registration Platform.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Establishment Registration of a Foreign-Invested Limited Liability Company, together with the duly signed Articles of Association, the sole shareholder's written decision, the First Board Resolution, and the Declaration of Legal Representative, Board Members, Supervisors and Senior Officers.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Under the PRC Company Law (2023), a Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise limited liability company has no statutory minimum paid-up capital and no blocked escrow account is required; the Articles of Association must specify the capital amount, contribution form, and contribution deadline. For a solar-farm EPC contracting WFOE, registered capital should be aligned with the construction qualification grading and tender creditworthiness, with a commercially prudent minimum of Renminbi 10,000,000 for a class-III electric power engineering general contracting qualification. Foreign capital contributions must be remitted through a SAFE-registered foreign exchange capital account and settled under the FDI foreign exchange registration procedures; the contribution commitment is published in the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
PRO-FORMA FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF [COMPANY NAME] WFOE LTD. 

RESOLVED, at the inaugural meeting of the board of directors of [Company Name] WFOE Ltd. (the 'Company'), held at [registered office address] at [time] on [date], pursuant to Article [X] of the Company's Articles of Association and the Company Law of the People's Republic of China, with [director names] present and constituting a quorum: 

1. SHARE CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION. The board reviewed the sole shareholder's decision dated [date] and approved the subscription of the Company's registered capital of [amount] [currency], allocated as [number] shares. The Chairman and the General Manager are directed to call the capital contributions according to the contribution schedule contained in the Articles of Association, to deposit the funds in the Company's foreign exchange capital account, and to complete the applicable Foreign Investment Information Report through the designated bank and the State Administration of Foreign Exchange. 

2. REGISTERED OFFICE. The board adopted the premises located at [full address] as the Company's statutory registered office and principal place of administration. The Legal Representative is directed to execute the lease, to obtain the property ownership or use-right certificate and building inspection documents, and to file the address with the Market Supervision Administration. 

3. BANKING AUTHORIZATION. The board designated [Bank Name], [Branch Address], as the Company's lead bank. The board authorized the opening of a basic deposit account, a general deposit account, a foreign exchange capital account, and project milestone and letter-of-credit facilities for the solar-farm EPC contracting business. The Legal Representative and the Chief Financial Officer, jointly or singly within the authorized amount matrix, are authorized to sign account opening documents, banking resolutions, electronic banking mandates, loan and guarantee agreements, and all ancillary instructions. 

4. STATUTORY OFFICERS. The board appointed the following officers: [Name], Chairman and Executive Director; [Name], Legal Representative; [Name], General Manager; [Name], Supervisor; and [Name], Chief Financial Officer. Each officer shall exercise the powers enumerated in the Articles of Association and the Company Law and shall act in the best interests of the Company and its shareholder. The Supervisor shall not concurrently hold any director or senior management position. 

5. CORPORATE INSTRUMENTS AND SEALS. The board created the company seal, financial seal, invoice seal, contract seal, and legal representative seal, and directed that each seal be engraved through a public-security-approved engraving vendor, held under dual custody, and used only upon written authorization by the Legal Representative or General Manager. 

6. AUTHORITY TO IMPLEMENT. The Chairman and the General Manager, acting jointly or either acting singly, are irrevocably empowered to sign and submit all applications, declarations, notices, and agreements necessary to register the Company with the State Administration for Market Regulation, the tax authority, social insurance agencies, housing provident fund bureau, foreign exchange authority, fire and civil defense authorities, and any industry licensing body for the solar-farm EPC business, and to retain counsel and advisors for that purpose. 

CERTIFIED by the undersigned Chairman this [day] of [month], [year]. 

/s/ [Chairman Name] Chairman of the Board of Directors

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Pre-Approval and Foreign-Invested Business Scope Verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SAMR/Municipal Market Supervision Administration name-registration module on the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System, accessed through the China Integrated Enterprise Registration Platform or the local MSA service hall.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log on to the enterprise registration portal, create a natural-person or agent account, and submit a proposed Chinese company name comprising the administrative division, distinctive mark, business character, and company type. Select the WFOE entity type and declare the registered capital and investor details. The system screens the name against prohibited and identical names and the foreign investment negative list. For a solar-farm EPC contracting WFOE, the declarant should simultaneously enter business scope terms such as 'photovoltaic power station engineering construction', 'general contracting of electric power engineering', 'solar energy engineering design and technical services', and 'electrical installation and commissioning' so that the name verification certificate is issued in alignment with the intended economic activity. Submit the name pre-approval application and print the Name Pre-approval Notice.
required_dossiers: Proposed company name application form (online-generated)
Foreign investor's certificate of incorporation or business registration extract, notarized and legalized or apostilled as required, with certified English or Chinese translation
Identity certificate of the authorized representative or incorporation agent
Draft business scope and registered capital declaration
Power of attorney for the incorporation agent, if any
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected or suspended, modify the distinctive component and resubmit within 3 working days. If the negative list blocks a business scope, revise the scope to remove restricted activities or restructure the holding chain. If the platform requires manual review, submit a written explanation to the local MSA window and request an expedited administrative review.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Authentication of Articles of Association and First Board Resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary office in the PRC jurisdiction where the company will be registered, together with the notary/honorary consulate or apostille authority in the foreign investor's home jurisdiction, followed by submission to the municipal Market Supervision Administration.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The sole shareholder must execute the Articles of Association and the First Board Resolution in a formal bilingual or certified Chinese-language version, setting out registered capital, contribution schedule, registered address, governance structure, and statutory officers. The foreign investor's identity certificates must be notarized by the competent notary in the jurisdiction of domicile and legalized by the Chinese Embassy or Consulate, or apostilled under the Hague Apostille Convention, which applies to the PRC from 7 November 2023. The Legal Representative must sign specimen signatures, and the Supervisor must be appointed to prevent dual-hatting with directors or managers. The certified documents must be delivered to the local MSA together with the online pre-filed establishment application.
required_dossiers: Notarized and legalized or apostilled foreign investor identity documentation (e.g., certificate of incorporation, passport or equivalent)
Power of attorney appointing the person handling registration
Authenticated Chinese-language Articles of Association, original
Signed First Board Resolution, original
Residence or office lease agreement for the registered address, or property right certificate
Legal Representative and Supervisor identity documents and appointment letters
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the MSA queries the authenticity or translation of foreign documents, obtain an auxiliary local notarization or a certified translation and resubmit within 10 working days. If the lease document is defective, furnish a right-of-use certificate from the property owner or substitute a compliant registered address. If the Supervisor appointment conflicts with Company Law, adopt a new shareholder decision and re-file.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Establishment Registration and Issuance of Business License
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipal Market Supervision Administration, Enterprise Registration Section, through the China Integrated Enterprise Registration Platform or the MSA service hall window.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the completed Application for Establishment Registration of a Foreign-Invested Company, the approved name pre-approval notice, the authenticated Articles of Association, the First Board Resolution, investor qualification evidence, lease agreement, and statutory officer identity documents in one package online or in person. The MSA reviews the application for legal and formal compliance, assigns the Unified Social Credit Code, and issues the 'Business License for Enterprise Legal Person'. After issuance, the MSA system automatically transmits registration data to the tax, social insurance, housing fund, and statistical authorities under the 'One License with One Code' reform. The company must verify the registered scope and officer details on the license before accepting it.
required_dossiers: Business License establishment application form (system-generated)
Name Pre-approval Notice
Original Articles of Association, stamped and signed
First Board Resolution and sole shareholder's written decision
Notarized/legalized foreign investor certificates
Office lease or title certificate for the registered address
Identity cards or passports of Legal Representative, directors, Supervisor, General Manager, and Chief Financial Officer
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is rejected or suspended for verification of material matters, provide supplementary explanatory materials through the online platform within 15 days. If the business license is not generated within the SLA, contact the MSA window supervisor or the local administrative service center complaint desk for an expedited decision. If the domicile is flagged as questionable, submit a certificate of site use from the property management or local neighborhood committee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Statutory Procedures: Seal Carving, Bank Accounts, SAFE FDI Registration and Tax/Construction Permits
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Security Bureau-licensed seal engraving vendors; the selected licensed commercial bank; the local branch of the State Administration of Foreign Exchange or the bank's delegated FDI registration desk; the municipal tax bureau; and the provincial or city housing and urban-rural development bureau and emergency management bureau for construction qualifications and work safety permits.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 30 days of obtaining the business license, the company must have the company seal, financial seal, invoice seal, contract seal, and legal representative seal engraved through a PSB-registered vendor and record the seal specimens with the local police station. Open the basic deposit account at a licensed commercial bank, complete the fiscal and tax registration matters, and apply for invoice issuance. For foreign capital, complete the FDI information registration with SAFE through the designated bank and open a foreign exchange capital account to receive the subscribed capital. If the company will physically perform solar-farm EPC works, apply to the provincial MOHURD window for the electric power engineering construction general contracting qualification (grade III or above) and the construction enterprise work safety production license, and to the National Energy Administration regional office for the power installation (repair/test) permit where high-voltage electrical installation is within scope.
required_dossiers: Business License, original
Legal Representative identity certificate
Seal engraving authorization issued by the MSA
Articles of Association and First Board Resolution for bank account opening
SAFE FDI registration application, capital contribution commitment letter, and foreign exchange business registration form
Tax registration and invoice application forms
Social insurance and housing provident fund registration forms

Construction enterprise qualification application forms, technical personnel qualification certificates, safety production responsibility system documents, and audit reports for MOHURD, MEM, and NEA permits
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank or SAFE rejects the FDI registration, rectify the capital account information and resubmit through the bank's compliance desk within 10 working days. If the construction qualification application is queried, submit supplemental certificates of technical personnel and past project performance within 10 working days. If the work safety production license is suspended, remedy the safety production responsibility documents, conduct the required on-site inspection, and request a re-inspection from the emergency management bureau.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development (MOHURD) of the PRC and its provincial or municipal housing and urban-rural development bureaus; Ministry of Emergency Management (MEM) and local emergency management bureaus; and the National Energy Administration (NEA) of the PRC, regional regulatory office.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Electric Power Engineering Construction General Contracting Qualification Certificate; Construction Enterprise Work Safety Production License; and Power Installation (Repair/Test) Permit for high-voltage electrical installation work within the solar-farm EPC scope.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Ecology and Environment (MEE) of the PRC and its provincial, municipal, and district ecology and environment bureaus.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Utility-scale solar-farm EPC construction is classified under the Catalogue of Environmental Impact Assessment for Construction Projects of the PRC, with the tier depending on installed capacity, land footprint, and ecological sensitivity. A Full Environmental Impact Report is required for projects located in ecologically sensitive areas or exceeding the land-use thresholds in the Catalogue. Most utility-scale ground-mounted solar farms require an Environmental Impact Report Form. Small distributed or rooftop projects below the thresholds may only require an Environmental Impact Registration Form or may be exempt. Where the EPC scope includes substations or high-voltage transmission lines, a separate EIA report or report form for electromagnetic fields and transmission-line construction may also be required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Construction-phase wastewater must comply with the Integrated Wastewater Discharge Standard GB 8978-1996, with pH 6-9, COD not exceeding 100 mg/L, suspended solids not exceeding 70 mg/L, and petroleum oils not exceeding 5 mg/L. Airborne particulate matter from construction works must comply with the Comprehensive Emission Standard of Air Pollutants GB 16297-1996, with process-source particulate matter not exceeding 120 mg/m3. Volatile organic compound emissions, mainly from painting, solvent cleaning, and electrical works, must comply with GB 37822-2019, including a non-methane total hydrocarbon boundary concentration limit of 2.0 mg/m3 or the stricter local standard adopted by the provincial ecology and environment bureau. Site-boundary construction noise must comply with GB 12523-2011, with a daytime limit of 70 dB(A) and a nighttime limit of 55 dB(A). Hazardous waste, including waste transformer oil, spent lead-acid batteries, and solvent waste, must be stored and managed under GB 18597-2023, transferred under the Hazardous Waste Manifest Management Regulations using the national electronic transfer manifest, and disposed of only by a licensed hazardous waste operator.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: The WFOE and its subcontractors must obtain, before physical works commence: (1) fire protection design review and fire completion acceptance certificates for permanent structures, inverters, transformer stations, and temporary site welfare facilities, issued by the local Fire and Rescue Division under the Fire Protection Law of the PRC; (2) a civil defense fire permit for the construction site, laydown yard, and temporary offices, including confirmation of access roads, fire hydrants, extinguisher placement, and emergency evacuation plans; (3) structural load and foundation inspection certificates for crane pads, piling equipment, and PV racking foundations under the Building Law and MOHURD engineering-quality regulations; (4) a work-safety pre-assessment and the construction enterprise work safety production license under the Work Safety Law; (5) filing of the emergency response plan with the local emergency management bureau; and (6) occupational hazard assessment and occupational disease prevention registration for workers exposed to dust, noise, welding fume, and high-voltage electromagnetic fields under the Law on the Prevention and Control of Occupational Diseases and its implementing regulations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration of the People's Republic of China (STA); electronic portals: e-Tax Bureau (Electronic Tax Administration) for tax registration and filing, the STA fully digitalized electronic invoice platform for VAT invoicing, and the China International Trade Single Window for export customs clearance.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The WFOE is incorporated with the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) and receives a business license bearing the 18-digit Unified Social Credit Code (USCC), which serves as the statutory Tax Identification Number (TIN) for corporate income tax, VAT, and all PRC tax filings. SAMR registration data is automatically exchanged with the tax authority; within 30 days of incorporation the WFOE must complete supplementary tax registration through the e-Tax Bureau portal, confirming legal representative, registered address, ISIC 4100 business scope, bank accounts, accounting system, invoice quota, VAT taxpayer status (general or small-scale), payroll withholding registration, and stamp duty registration. For a foreign non-resident enterprise with no establishment in China, no standalone PRC VAT registration is required; the domestic payer obtains a non-resident tax withholding record in the e-Tax Bureau and executes VAT and income tax withholding on payments subject to PRC tax.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. The PRC does not provide check-the-box entity classification or hybrid mismatch elections; a WFOE is mandatorily a resident enterprise taxed at entity level on worldwide income. VAT taxpayer status election (small-scale taxpayer below RMB 5 million annual turnover may elect general taxpayer status if accounting is sound) is an indirect-tax election, not an entity classification election.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: RMB 5,000,000 annual taxable turnover (mandatory general VAT taxpayer registration threshold); basic tax registration is compulsory for all entities from incorporation regardless of turnover. Below RMB 5,000,000, the WFOE may be a small-scale VAT taxpayer and may voluntarily elect general taxpayer status.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: VAT invoices must be issued through the STA electronic invoice service platform under Golden Tax System Phase IV. Fully digitalized electronic invoices (FDEI) are transmitted to the STA in real time, carry a unique STA-issued anti-counterfeit invoice number and encryption/verification code, and do not require a physical tax control device. General taxpayers must perform periodic VAT reconciliation through the e-Tax Bureau and verify all special VAT invoices against the national invoice verification platform. For the EPC supply, invoices must separate equipment sales at 13%, construction/installation services at 9%, and independently contracted design services at 6%; failure to separate may cause the entire supply to be recharacterized at the highest applicable rate.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods: exported solar equipment and materials are zero-rated if actually declared to China Customs, exported under a valid export declaration, and supported by receipt of foreign exchange; input VAT on the goods and attributable input services is recoverable through the export VAT rebate. Services: cross-border taxable services, including offshore engineering design, remote technical consultancy, and other services consumed wholly outside China and supplied to a non-resident customer under Caishui [2016] No. 36, may qualify for 0% VAT if the recipient is outside China, the service is not used in China, and payment is received from overseas. Domestic on-site EPC construction at a Chinese project site is a domestic taxable supply at 9% for construction services or 13% for separately supplied equipment and cannot be zero-rated.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: China Customs Export Declaration (Export Goods Declaration Form) with a customs assignment number, lodged through the China International Trade Single Window
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical export movement of the goods
Inward Remittance Certificate (FIRC) or bank foreign-exchange receipt voucher confirming export proceeds were repatriated to the WFOE's China account
Export sales contract and commercial invoice stating the goods, Incoterms, value, and 0% VAT treatment
Packing list and customs commodity inspection or customs valuation documents, where applicable
Zero-rated export sales invoice (ordinary VAT invoice or fully digitalized electronic invoice) clearly marked 0% and linked to the export declaration
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Unverified or fraudulent zero-rating is clawed back retroactively: output VAT at the applicable rate (13% for goods or 9% for construction services) is reassessed from the date of export or invoice, a late-payment surcharge of 0.05% per day accrues from the due date, and a tax penalty of 50% to 500% of the underpaid tax may be imposed under the Law on Administration of Tax Collection and its implementing rules. In cases of fraudulent export tax refund, the refund is recovered without limitation period, the taxpayer loses export rebate status, administrative disqualification and blacklisting apply, and criminal liability for fraudulent export refund under the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China may be pursued. Failure to repatriate export proceeds within 180 days also triggers SAFE foreign-exchange penalties and may invalidate the zero-rating evidence.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: People's Bank of China (PBOC); the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) acts as the delegated enforcement agency for all currency and cross-border payment rules.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: China maintains a managed floating exchange rate and a bifurcated convertibility system. Current account transactions (trade in goods and services) are fully convertible in practice: banks verify documentation such as contracts, invoices and customs declarations, then settle automatically. Capital account transactions remain closely monitored. Foreign direct investment enters via a two-step SAFE registration (FDI foreign exchange registration and later equity change/FDI reinvestment registration). Invested foreign exchange capital is held in a dedicated capital account; each use requires a payment-into-account review against the registered business scope. Repatriation of stated capital before liquidation is prohibited; liquidation proceeds can be remitted after tax clearance. Profit remittance is open but subject to bank verification of the audited financial statements, tax payment certificates, and a one-off registration. Dividends to parent are treated as current account payments and do not require a separate SAFE approval, but the bank must maintain the dividend drawer copy and the source enterprise's foreign exchange annual report. The CNY exchange rate follows a crawling peg with reference to a basket; the PBOC daily fixing plus a trading band makes full market-determined convertibility unavailable. Enterprises cannot freely arbitrage between onshore and offshore RMB; transactions must have genuine underlying business. Overall, the territory is non-convertible on the capital account and significantly but administratively convertible on the current account.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no mandatory conversion ratio under the current SAFE measures; all export foreign exchange receipts must be repatriated to mainland China and deposited into a current account foreign exchange account or settled into RMB at the bank's daily spot rate. The statutory timeframe for collection is 90 days from the date of export declaration; companies expecting payment beyond 90 days may file a deferred collection registration at the bank before the expiry. Failure to collect within the period without a valid registration triggers a trade credibility classification downgrade and may restrict future payment settlement.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore digital EMIs (e.g., Airwallex, OFX) are legally barred from acting as the primary clearing bank for a mainland WFOE under the People's Bank of China's licensing framework. The State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) licensing regime requires all capital account inflows, FX conversion, and current account settlement to pass through a licensed domestic commercial bank. Unlicensed fintech platforms may be engaged only for ancillary services such as cloud-hosted treasury dashboards or tariff collection, but they cannot legally hold corporate funds as a deposit-taking institution. Consequently, the viability of using an EMI as the main treasury rail is low and would expose the WFOE to regulatory non-compliance, frozen funds, and inability to complete SAFE online clearance.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: According to PBOC and SAFE rules, a physical in-branch interview is mandatory before the opening of a WFOE's capital account; the legal representative or a board-appointed signatory must appear with the original seal (company chop), incorporation certificate, foreign investor passport, and a notarized board resolution. Remote consular proxy opening is not accepted for the initial KYC due diligence and secure-signature requirement. After the account is live, qualified treasury operators may execute daily transactions through e-banking token or treasury workstation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) is a non-PRC natural person or opaque offshore chain
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a full corporate ownership cascade from the UBO to the WFOE, certified Chinese translation of the parent registry extract, identity and proof-of-residence for every natural person holding 10% or more, a notarized statement of no PEP status, and a global sanctions screening report (OFAC, EU, UN, and Chinese MOFCOM) for each UBO.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Capital injection source-of-funds cannot be proven
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Deliver 12 months of bank statements for the overseas investor, showing accumulated balances, a signed undertaking on the commercial substance, tax-paid proofs or employment income records for individual investors, and a formal board resolution approving the injection amount and purpose.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: EPC milestone payments show circularity or no underlying construction
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide the full set of executed EPC contracts with schedules, engineering drawings and BOM, subcontractor agreements, evidenced purchase invoices, project site photographs, progress certification by a licensed engineer, and a comparison of the invoiced amount against the contracted milestone plan.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Materials or counterparties appear on sanctions or convicted lists
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Deliver a KYC pack for all suppliers and subcontractors, including legal address, ownership, registry, and an independent external trade-compliance declaration; commit to screening transactions against the consolidated Chinese and international sanctions lists and include contractual clauses allowing audit and termination for any sanctioned-party reference.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The initial foreign capital contribution must be wired from the foreign shareholder's own bank account to the WFOE's capital FX account at a licensed mainland branch, after the SAFE Foreign-Invested Enterprise Foreign Exchange Registration has been completed online through the bank. The wire must carry the SAFE-compliant purpose code for capital injection to establish a foreign-invested enterprise and the beneficiary ID field must match the SAFE registration number. Upon receipt, the bank credits the payment-funds-to-be-verified ledger; the WFOE must provide a CPA capital verification report, a board resolution on fund usage, and a detailed project procurement plan before converting to RMB. Each capital disbursement must be submitted through the bank's foreign exchange monitoring system and receipts/reports must be filed.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Liquidity clearing for procurement and subcontracting should use SWIFT MT103 messages over the domestic bank's international clearing justification platform for direct overseas payments. For large-scale import of PV modules and inverters, an irrevocable confirmed commercial letter of credit (L/C) or a documentary collection (D/P) may be issued by the sponsor bank, especially when the transaction is based on a contract, pro-forma invoice, bill of lading and inspection certificate. Chinese banks also offer RMB cross-border clearing via CNAPS and the Cross-Border Interbank Payment System (CIPS) for Chinese counter-contracts. All outbound disbursements require the enterprise to provide the original contract, invoice, customs or port document, and a foreign exchange payment purpose declaration; the bank will encode the payment in the SAFE FX payment origin classification for trade in goods.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore RMB deliverable forward contracts (DF) against genuinely outstanding current-account or foreign-loan exposures, valid to 1 year, executed with the same FX clearing bank after providing an underlying documentation and window assessment
Cross-currency swaps and FX swaps for managing repetition of long-term project funding, restricted to banks with SAFE market maker authorisation and subject to real exposure inspection

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) executed offshore through the WFOE's group treasury centre in Hong Kong or Singapore for CNH conversion risk only, not for onshore CNY rates; onshore NDFs are not permitted for general corporate entities
FX options in plain vanilla calls or puts against real exposure with maturity matching the underlying settlement during term

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax (CIT) Final Settlement Filing and Payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) of the People's Republic of China
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within five calendar months after the end of each tax year, i.e., no later than 31 May of the following calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing and payment attract a 0.05% daily overdue surcharge on the unpaid tax from the statutory deadline until full payment; administrative penalties of RMB 2,000 to RMB 10,000 for late filing; penalties of 50% to 5 times the amount of evaded tax for intentional non-filing or under-declaration; compulsory enforcement measures such as bank account freezes and asset seizures for prolonged arrears; in severe cases, the legal representative may be restricted from leaving China.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Disclosure Report including the Foreign Investment Annual Report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) through the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System; transmitted concurrently to the Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) for foreign investment statistics
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: From 1 January to 30 June of every calendar year for the preceding calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file by the 30 June deadline results in inclusion in the List of Enterprises with Abnormal Operations; a grace period of up to three years is permitted, after which the enterprise is placed on the Serious Violation of Law and Dishonesty List; administrative fines of RMB 10,000 to RMB 30,000 may be imposed; in cases where no report is filed for three consecutive years, the market regulator may revoke the business license.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Pursuant to Article 164 of the PRC Company Law and Article 31 of the PRC Foreign Investment Law, every Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise (WFOE) is unconditionally required to have its annual financial statements audited by a licensed Chinese CPA firm, regardless of asset size, turnover or headcount; no de minimis exemption is available for a WFOE. For quantitative benchmarking, an EPC or construction entity will also trigger a mandatory statutory audit under common local supervision standards if any of the following is exceeded: (i) total assets equal to or above RMB 50 million (approximately USD 6.9 million); (ii) annual operating revenue equal to or above RMB 60 million (approximately USD 8.3 million); or (iii) average headcount equal to or above 200 employees. The WFOE obligation is absolute and applies even below these thresholds.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Chinese Accounting Standards (CAS), which are substantially converged with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS). A WFOE incorporated in Mainland China must apply full CAS for statutory reporting and audit purposes; the simplified Small Enterprise Accounting Standards are not available to foreign-invested enterprises.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under the Regulations on the Administration of Market Entity Registration, any change in the registered shareholding, capital structure or beneficial ownership of the WFOE must be lodged with the local State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) within 30 days of the occurrence of the change. As part of the annual disclosure report, due no later than 30 June, the WFOE confirms the then-current shareholding and ultimate beneficial ownership percentages. Failure to file the 30-day change report subjects the entity to correction orders, administrative fines for non-compliance, restrictions on further equity changes, and possible revocation of the business license in serious cases.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Shareholders) with Capital Contribution Records
Register of Directors, Supervisors and Senior Management
Minute Book of Shareholders' Meetings and Board Resolutions

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: 500 - 2,000 USD per year for a compliant registered address or physical office in a business center; 300 - 1,500 USD per year for professional corporate secretarial and registered agent services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: 2,000 - 15,000 USD per year depending on turnover, asset size, number of projects, intercompany transactions and audit complexity; for a mid-size EPC contractor the typical fee ranges from 8,000 to 12,000 USD

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: The standard PRC Corporate Income Tax rate is 25%. A Qualified High-and-New Technology Enterprise can obtain a reduced 15% rate. R&D expenses generally qualify for an additional 100% deduction. Small low-profit enterprises may use concessional effective rates below 25%. For this solar EPC contractor, no free-zone or patent-box holiday applies, and the 3-plus-3 public infrastructure project tax holiday is restricted to qualifying project operators, not pure turnkey EPC contractors.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form A100000 Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (A-Class) and related schedules filed electronically through the State Taxation Administration e-Tax China portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual return and final payment must be filed within 5 months after the fiscal year-end, ordinarily by May 31; quarterly provisional CIT prepayments are due within 15 days after the close of each quarter; withholding tax on outbound non-resident remittances is due within 15 days after the payment becomes due.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 – Enterprise Identification and Taxpayer Profile
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax registration number, legal representative, registered address, industry classification, enterprise type, fiscal year, accounting basis, and reporting currency.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Mark the entity as a Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise with foreign investment; identify the ultimate offshore parent and place of effective management; disclose any permanent establishment outside China; align data with the foreign investment registration system and bank settlement records; mismatches trigger cross-border anti-tax-avoidance review.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2 – Revenue and Construction Milestone Recognition
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Line 1 operating revenue, principally EPC contract income from utility-scale photovoltaic engineering, procurement, and construction.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Recognize revenue under percentage-of-completion or milestone method consistent with the contract and audited financial statements; exclude VAT; include all worldwide income of the resident WFOE, but allocate China-source and foreign-source revenue separately for foreign tax credit purposes; services performed and construction site located in China create China-source taxable income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 3 – Cost of Sales, Site Expenses and Subcontracting
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Line 2 operating cost, plus selling, administrative and financial expenses; material, labor, equipment, subcontractor and financing costs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Capitalize costs properly attributable to the construction milestone; deduct material purchases only with verifiable VAT invoices; intercompany module or inverter purchases from offshore affiliates must be priced at arm's length; management fees paid to a non-resident parent are deductible only with real service evidence and no duplication; entertainment expenses are subject to statutory add-back limitations.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 4 – Tax Adjustments and Non-Deductible Items
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Line 15 tax adjustments, temporary and permanent differences, thin capitalization, related-party interest, and transfer pricing adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reconcile accounting profit to taxable income; add back excessive related-party interest under the debt-equity ratio rules; disallow management fees lacking economic substance; include all related-party offshore payments in the annual related-party transaction report; where a shareholder loan exceeds 2:1 for non-financial enterprises, the excess interest is non-deductible.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 5 – Taxable Income and Tax Computation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Lines 16 through 22: taxable income, applicable rate, tax payable, exemptions and reductions, foreign tax credits, and net tax due.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply 25% to EPC contracting income; do not apply a DTA rate to CIT at entity level because DTA reductions apply only to outbound withholding payments; claim foreign tax credits on foreign-source income using separate-country and separate-category rules; maintain Tax Residency Certificate and full source documentation for any offshore revenue.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 6 – Non-Resident Withholding Declaration and Outbound Remittances
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Supplementary schedules for dividend distributions, interest, royalties, and service fees paid to non-resident shareholders and affiliates.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The WFOE, as withholding agent, must declare and remit 10% statutory WHT on dividends, interest, and royalties paid abroad unless a treaty reduction is substantiated; before applying a DTA rate, collect the Tax Residency Certificate and Beneficial Ownership declaration from the payee; failure to withhold gives rise to personal liability of the responsible director and the WFOE.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 7 – Loss Carryforward, Credits and Prior-Year Amended Adjustments
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Loss schedules, carryforward positions, prior-year refund and correction entries, and reconciliation with audited balance sheet.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Standard CIT loss carryforward is 5 years for this WFOE; carryforward is not portable on share-transfer or offshore migration; tax authority TP adjustments may reduce loss utilization; a restructure or merger changes loss survival; disclose every amendment to preserve exchange control and bank clearing approvals.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 8 – Signature Certification, Director Accountability and Official Filing
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal representative declaration, accountant certification, seal, and acknowledgment that the return is true and complete.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The legal representative and responsible financial officer sign as individuals; false invoicing, inflated cost entries, and deliberate omission of related-party transactions create personal criminal exposure under the PRC Criminal Law and the Law on the Administration of Tax Collection; signature also supports piercing the corporate veil where directors caused the evasion.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalties under the PRC Law on the Administration of Tax Collection: up to CNY 2,000 for ordinary cases and CNY 2,000-10,000 for serious non-filing; late payment surcharge is 0.05% of unpaid tax per day; non-payment after tax authority assessment can trigger seizure and blacklisting; deliberate false filing evading tax above CNY 50,000 and exceeding 10% of payable tax gives criminal liability under Criminal Law Article 201 with imprisonment up to 7 years; false VAT invoicing under Article 205 can be punished by imprisonment up to life.
